'''Immerse Another''' was a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] [[Fallanassi powers|power]]. The power allowed a Fallanassi to immerse something else in the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]]; this could be a person, item, [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or even something up to the size of a [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="CTD" />
